fields.Notes:
MBA (International Business) [NCR-032]: Split grouped IB/HRD/BA row into separate programmes. Official 2026 IB report supersedes 2025 IB mean 13.92/median 15.17/high 30. Median above mean is as published, not transposed. Annual fee table numeric 57,279 agrees with sum; words 53,980 conflict flagged.

MBA (Human Resource Development) [NCR-212]: Programme split from previous grouped DSE row. Latest official HRD report image footer explicitly states 2025–26: mean 14.60, median 15.50, highest 20.50 LPA; visually inspected original image. These replace prior 2024–25 mean 13, median 12, high 20.5. Annual fee numeric ₹57,279 and line-item sum agree; amount-in-words ₹53,980 is stale. Two-year fee 1.14558 L is derived at unchanged annual rate.

MBA (Business Analytics) [NCR-213]: New programme separation from previous grouped DS Erow. Official 2026–27 brochure 2024–25 BA mean 12.5/high 23.5; student-managed programme webpage 2025 saysmean 13/high 23.5, discrepancy flagged rather than averaged. Fee annual numeric 57,279 and line items agree; words text 53,980 is as tale inconsistency. Two-year 1.14558 L derived at unchanged annual rate.
